#### List:

- Intro
- Structure
- Functions
- Illustrations

#### Intro:

- Intracellular organelle
- For energy production
- Abundant in metabolically active tissue
- Absent in few cells e.g. RBC
- Own DNA, maternal inheritance

#### Structure:

![](/content/exams/anzca/2013/A/14/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Mitochondrial outer and inner membranes, intermembrane space and matrix"}

#### Functions:

+-----------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolic | - Oxidative phosphorylation (inner membrane)        |
|           |   - 36 mol ATP per molecule of glucose              |
|           | - Citric acid cycle (matrix)                        |
|           | - β-oxidation of fatty acids (matrix)               |
+-----------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Other     | - Thermogenesis                                     |
|           |   - Uncoupling protein inserted into inner membrane |
|           |   - Passage of H^+^ without ATP formation           |
|           |   - Only in brown fat                               |
|           |   - Activated by adrenaline at β~3~ receptor        |
|           | - Apoptosis                                         |
|           | - Calcium sequestration                             |
|           | - Drug biotransformation                            |
+-----------+-----------------------------------------------------+
